description: Prerequisite: caller's moderation level strictly higher than the target's. Effect: sends ArchiveModerationRequest{REJECT_USER, EntityId=target_user_id} on the city socket. Server pushes VerificationNotification{IsVerified=false} to the target's live sessions and closes them. Does NOT ban the user — they can retry verification. Cost: none. No persistent DB mutation (unlike approve). No response PDU. Note: EntityId is a user_id, NOT an avatar_id. Non-admin callers refused in the bot handler.

args.name: target_user_id
args.description: fso_users.user_id of the pending user. This is NOT an avatar_id.
